div.head: II As 9
div.ab: Be yrfes ætfenge. Se ðe yfre befó, nemne him mon V men his neahgebura, ⁊ begite ðara V: I, ðæt him midswerige, þæt he hit on folcryht him toteo; ⁊ se þe hit him geagnian wille, nemne him mon X men, ⁊ begite þara twegen ⁊ sylle þone að, þæt hit on his æhte geboren wære, buton þam rimaðe; ⁊ stonde þes cyreoþ ofer XX penega.

He who attaches livestock shall have five men nominated to him from among his neighbours, and he shall select one of the five to swear with him that he is attaching the livestock in accordance with public law. And he who wishes to maintain his claim [to the livestock] shall have ten men nominated to him, and he shall select two of them without calling for the testimony of the whole number, and swear an oath that the livestock was born in his possession. Recourse shall be had to this selected oath when the stock exceeds the value of 20 pence.

Be ðonne ðe yrf befehþe. And se ðe yfre befo, namne hine mon fif men his nehbura, ⁊ begite ðara fifa ænne, þæt him swerige mid, þæt he him on folcrihte toteo; ⁊ se ðe hit him agnian wille, nemne him mon X men, ⁊ begyte ðæra II ⁊ sylle þone aþ, þæt hit on his æhte geboren wære, butan ðæm rimaþe; ⁊ stande ðes cyreaþ ofer XX peninga.
